interpretation.result: For all six mechanically selected common status-move information patterns, the generator-conditioned hidden-item posterior is a reproducible singleton across disjoint deterministic seed families.
interpretation.implication: A status-move live extension should not invent a generic Choice-like item prior. For these treatments, public move/species evidence collapses the item before exact transition search.
interpretation.next_required_falsifier: Run an exact pinned-Showdown public-belief treatment on a frozen natural status-move decision using the singleton generator-conditioned item support.

non_claims: This does not promote status-move observations into the live player.
This does not establish competitive-optimal play.
This does not prove singleton item support for every species or status-move information state.
